subject: Integration readiness: SDK auth, egress proxy, and embedding/reranker routing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Nora Price <nora.price@cloudbridge.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + tech asks (SDK auth, egress, embeddings/rerank)

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great discussion. Quick recap and clear next steps so our engineering teams can align before the sandbox POC:

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for internal search augmentation + reranker for top-k candidate refinement, with embeddings stored in your existing vector DB.
- Scope items we promised to clarify: SDK auth pattern, preferred routing (VPC endpoint vs egress proxy), DNS/egress requirements, mTLS cert expectations, and structured output / tool-calling for the reranker pipeline.

High-level asks from CloudBridge we captured:
1) Provide the list of outbound IPs for allowlisting on your side OR guidance for a VPC endpoint setup.
2) Recommend an SDK auth pattern supporting short-lived tokens and an optional token-exchange flow for service-to-service calls.
3) Confirm whether the reranker will call Redwood as a server-side service (recommended) or via client devices.
4) Share any compliance constraints around certs or internal PKI for mTLS.

Attachments: redwood_sdk_auth_flow.pdf (auth flow diagram), egress-ip-list.csv (current hosted egress IPs), mTLS_cert_instructions.txt (how we prefer certs to be presented).

Proposed next steps:
- CloudBridge: confirm whether you prefer a VPC endpoint or IP allowlist approach by EOD Thurs (5/14).
- Redwood: bench plan for a small reranker POC (we'll scope token usage & structured output templates).
- Schedule a 30-min network call (networking + security engineers) if you select VPC endpoint.

If that matches your notes, we'll kick off the POC checklist and share an integration playbook.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Integrations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Jonas Weber
Redwood Inference

From: Nora Price <nora.price@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + tech asks (SDK auth, egress, embeddings/rerank)

Appreciate the clear recap — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our infra/security side:

1) For initial evaluation we'd prefer IP allowlisting (easier for our sandbox). We'll share a firewall rule on our end. Please confirm the exact outbound IPs you've attached as egress-ip-list.csv — there's a mix of CIDR ranges and single IPs.
2) For auth we prefer a short-lived bearer token model. Ideally we run a token broker in our VPC and exchange internal service creds for Redwood tokens (token-exchange). Can you confirm the introspection endpoint and token lifetime?
3) Regarding reranker: our plan is server-side within our microservice that assembles candidates, calls Redwood for reranking, then persists results. So low-latency server-to-server is the priority.
4) mTLS: we use internal PKI; we can present certs signed by our root CA. If Redwood requires a specific format (PEM chain, separate key upload), please let us know.

I'll loop in our network lead (Samir) on the follow-ups. We can do the network call next Tue (5/18) morning PST if that works for you.

Thanks,
Nora Price
Head of Platform Engineering
CloudBridge
Nora.Price@cloudbridge.com

Attachment: egress-ip-list.csv

Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap + tech asks (SDK auth, egress, embeddings/rerank)

Forwarding Nora's reply and adding some proposed engineering decisions so we don't lose momentum. TL;DR: recommend supporting both flows (VPC endpoint + IP allowlist) for the POC, but start with allowlist for speed.

Short tech plan (POC):
- Network: Use allowlist for sandbox. If CloudBridge elects VPC endpoint later, we'll provide our endpoint manifest and a short runbook. Owner: Laura.
- Auth: Support token-exchange pattern. Implement an OAuth client credentials flow for the token broker with short-lived Redwood tokens (t- = 15m). Expose token introspection endpoint for troubleshooting. Owner: Jonas (design), Laura (implement).
- Routing: For low-latency server->server reranker calls, recommend persistent http/2 connections and keepalive on the SDK. We should provide connection settings in the SDK docs.
- Structured output/tool-calling: We'll add a sample structured output schema for the reranker to return classification + confidence + tool-call trigger for enrichment. Owner: Product Docs (I'll coordinate).
- Embeddings: Confirm vector DB client will host nearest-neighbor; Redwood returns embeddings/metrics but not host the index. We need to show example flow for hashing IDs and correlation.

Action items before Tue network call:
1) Confirm final outbound IP list and whether they want VPC endpoint later. (Nora)
2) Laura to draft VPC endpoint manifest + mTLS cert requirements.
3) Jonas to hand off SDK token-exchange spec and create example token broker snippet.

Forwarding Nora's message below.

- Ben

Redwood Inference

Subject: Integration checklist & timeline for sandbox POC

Hi Nora / Samir — thanks, this is actionable. Below is a concrete checklist and estimated timeline for the sandbox POC. Please review and confirm the items you own so we can lock the network call slot on Tue 5/18 10:00 AM PST.

Redwood deliverables (by Tue 5/18):
- SDK token-exchange spec (OAuth client_credentials + short-lived Redwood tokens) — attachment: redwood_sdk_auth_flow.pdf (Owner: Jonas)
- Sample SDK config for HTTP/2 keepalive and best-practice headers for reranker calls (Owner: Laura)
- VPC endpoint manifest (manifest includes required ports, route table note) — draft attached if you move to peering (Owner: Laura)
- Structured output template for reranker responses (classification + confidence + tool_trigger) — PR to docs repo (Owner: Product Docs)

CloudBridge deliverables (before network call):
- Confirm whether we should proceed with IP allowlist for sandbox or start VPC endpoint work (please reply with one).
- Share the exact firewall rule snippet and the source CIDRs in egress-ip-list.csv.
- Confirm mTLS cert format (PEM chain + separate private key) and whether certs will be signed by your internal root CA.

Proposed timeline:
- 5/14 EOD: CloudBridge confirms allowlist vs VPC endpoint.
- 5/18 10:00 AM PST: network call (30m) — confirm connection settings + cert exchange.
- 5/25: Redwood provides sandbox credentials & example reranker flow.

Quick answers to specific questions from your note:
- Token introspection endpoint: https://auth.redwood.inference.com/introspect (we'll provide a temporary test endpoint for POC).
- Token lifetime for POC: 15 minutes. We support refresh/exchange via client credentials.
- mTLS format: we accept PEM chain + separate .key file; we can also support MTLS using mutual TLS through our gateway if you supply signed certs. See attached mTLS_cert_instructions.txt for details.

Please confirm the following in a reply:
- Decision: allowlist OR VPC endpoint?
- Preferred slot for network call if Tue 5/18 10:00 AM PST does not work.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
